prompts.sit-front:
Use case: precise local ear-tip edit to an existing transparent Odin cat sprite. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and immutable identity/pose/material/framing master. Images 2 and 3 are approved REAL PHOTOS OF ODIN; use them only to understand compact solid pinnae and fine semi-transparent ear-tip hairs. Primary request: fix ONLY the exaggerated solid pointed extensions at the outer tips of each visible ear. Keep the natural small triangular ear/pinna, ear canal, inner-ear fur and ear orientation stable. Replace the dark, opaque long spike beyond the normal pinna with a very small number of thin, wispy, separated, tapering hairs. Some true transparent gaps between individual hair tips; extensions should read as delicate fur, not solid elongated triangular tissue. Not long lynx tufts, not feathers, not pom-poms, not bristles or electric bushy hair. Shorten only the excessive solid extensions; do not round off the entire ear, remove the ear, enlarge the ears or make them flat. Preserve the rest of image 1 as faithfully as possible: face, eyes and Odin's asymmetric eye identity, head size, nose, whiskers, body, original fur texture and contrast, markings, all paws and tail, approved flattened contact fur and existing proportions. Do not regenerate a differently styled cat or alter any other feature. Match original framing, canvas, pose placement and transparent padding, including large empty upper space where present. Preserve real alpha transparency, no floor, shadow, line, background, UI or text. Fully include all ear hairs, whiskers, paws and tail within the canvas; do not clip the far-right ear. One cat sprite only.
Specific target pose: sit-front. Keep the just-approved horizontal floor-smooshed underside and rounded overhanging paws exactly.
